description: This file defines functions for retrieving leaderboard data and related queries in an ERP system, specifically for customers, items, suppliers, sales partners, and sales persons, using the Frappe framework.

methods.name: get_leaderboards
methods.description: Returns a dictionary defining various leaderboards for customers, items, suppliers, sales partners, and sales persons.

methods.name: get_all_customers
methods.description: Fetches customer-related data such as outstanding amounts or sales totals within a date range and for a specific company.

methods.name: get_all_items
methods.description: Retrieves item data such as stock quantities, sales, or purchase amounts based on specified fields and date range.

methods.name: get_all_suppliers
methods.description: Fetches supplier data including outstanding amounts or purchase totals within a date range for a given company.

methods.name: get_all_sales_partner
methods.description: Retrieves sales partner data such as total sales or commissions within a date range.

methods.name: get_all_sales_person
methods.description: Fetches sales person data with total sales within a date range.

methods.name: get_date_condition
methods.description: Constructs a SQL date condition clause based on a date range.
